posts.theme: Launch: 1,585 good days out on one map
posts.text:
We just put 1,585 good days out on one map, in every county in Missouri. 🗺️

Lunch and cards at the senior center. A slow loop around the lake. Pie on the courthouse square. The county fair. That museum they have meant to see for years.

Type any Missouri town or ZIP code and see what is closest. It is free for anyone to use, so share it with a friend who is looking for ideas for Mom or Dad.
